data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘Ossa’, meaning ‘bone’ or ‘little one’. This name was given to infants or young children. In Christian tradition, it is also associated with Osias, a name given to several biblical prophets. The name Ossie carries the meaning “Little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ossie usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Ossius
in_latin.meaning: nomen significans sapientiam, locum, tempus, vel modum
in_latin.long_meaning: Ossius (nominative) - nomen, quod significat sapientiam, locum, tempus, vel modum, ex radicibus etymologicis, originem habens in lingua Hebraea, à laudibus sapientiae, loci, temporis, et modi. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Ossius, in memoria sancti Ossii, Episcopi Cordubensis, celebratur, qui in Concilio Niceno, fuit, et in sua vita, sapientia, et sanctitas, exemplum, fuit multorum. Hoc nomen, in lingua Latina, per mutationem, in formam Ossii, factum est, et in usu, est, ut nomen, significans sapientiam, locum, tempus, vel modum, in cultura, et historia, Christiana.

in_english.meaning: name signifying wisdom, place, time, or manner, derived from Hebraic roots
in_english.long_meaning: Ossie - a name signifying wisdom, place, time, or manner, derived from Hebraic roots, with origin in the Bible, à laudibus sapientiae, loci, temporis, et modi, reflecting the qualities of wisdom, place, time, or manner, as seen in the life of Saint Ossius, Bishop of Cordoba, who was a wise and holy leader, and a model of spiritual guidance, in the early Christian Church. This name, in English usage, has undergone a transformation, in form, and has become a name, signifying wisdom, place, time, or manner, in Christian culture and history, often associated with qualities of intelligence, prudence, and foresight, in individuals who bear this name.
